# F1 · Squad state — knowing what is actually in the team

*Extracted verbatim from the PRD, which remains the single source of truth for every criterion below. Edit the PRD, then regenerate — never edit this file.*

Identifiers in this file: `F1-AC-01` – `F1-UP-04`.

#### F1 · Squad state — knowing what is actually in the team

| Section | Detail |
| --- | --- |
| Priority | **Must.** The squad read every other feature depends on. |
| Serves | The first core job in Section 2.3: no call can be judged without the squad it applies to. |
| Happy path | The manager opens the app. It calls FPL's public data feed, establishes the current gameweek and its deadline, loads the squad as at the last completed deadline, and renders it as a formation. |
| **Acceptance Criteria** |  |
| **F1-AC-01** | Exactly fifteen players are shown: two goalkeepers, five defenders, five midfielders, three forwards. |
| **F1-AC-02** | Eleven are starters and four are bench, in a fixed bench order — goalkeeper, then outfield one, two, three. |
| **F1-AC-03** | Formation is derived from the starting eleven and displayed as text, never as a control the manager can change. |
| **F1-AC-04** | All eleven starters are visible without scrolling the screen. |
| **F1-AC-05** | The four-player bench card is visible without scrolling the screen. |
| **F1-AC-06** | The header shows the deadline as date and time. |
| **F1-AC-07** | The header shows the Balance and the free transfers remaining. |
| **F1-AC-08** | The header shows four chip discs, each in an available or spent state. |
| **F1-AC-09** | An *Update* control sits at the end of the chip row and opens the squad-correction flow (F2). |
| **F1-AC-10** | Each player slot shows kit, shirt number and surname. |
| **F1-AC-11** | Each player slot shows a fixture pill naming opponent and home or away, coloured by difficulty: 1–2 green, 3 amber, 4–5 red. |
| **F1-AC-12** | Injury or doubt status shows as a small coloured marker on the player — red for injured, amber for a doubt percentage. |
| **F1-AC-13** | Captain and vice-captain show as badges on their slots. |
| **F1-AC-14** | No prices appear on the pitch. |
| **F1-AC-15** | The stat table shows the same fifteen with the master column list — Player, Availability, Form, xPts, This gameweek, price, selected-by percentage, points, transfers in and transfers out (defined once in 3.1, Squad · stat table) — grouped by position. |
| **F1-AC-16** | The stat table's player column is frozen: name and club stay pinned to the left in the header row and in every row. |
| **F1-AC-17** | The stat table's header row is sticky on the other axis, holding position while the rows scroll vertically, so a figure never loses either its row or its column. |
| **F1-AC-18** | Bench players carry a red circular badge beside the name: **S** for the substitute goalkeeper, **S1 / S2 / S3** for the outfield bench in order. |
| **F1-AC-19** | **The next-three difficulty bars are specified here and nowhere else.** The stat table's *This gameweek* column shows the fixture pill and, beneath it, three hairline bars giving the difficulty of the next three fixtures on the same 1–5 colour scale. In a normal week the first bar matches the pill. |
| **F1-AC-20** | The head-to-head evaluation table's fixtures row (F3) reuses that identical three-bar strip on each side. Those two are the only places it appears. |
| **F1-AC-21** | The pitch carries the fixture pill alone and no bars — so any reference to "the first difficulty bar" anywhere in this document means the stat table's strip and the head-to-head row, never the player slot. |
| **F1-AC-22** | Squad and bench projected-points totals are summed from the per-gameweek projections of the players shown and never stored separately, so no total can disagree with the players it represents. |
| **Unhappy Paths** |  |
| **F1-UP-01** | **A player has no fixture this gameweek (blank).** Acceptance: the marker stays full strength and is never dimmed — dimming means rejected or spent; the fixture pill reads NO GAME in grey with a dashed border; the first difficulty bar becomes an empty dashed track, because a blank is not a difficulty of zero; that player's projected points are 0.0; the pitch carries a corner figure counting the blanks. |
| **F1-UP-02** | **A player has two fixtures this gameweek (double).** Acceptance: the pill reads the opponent with a "×2" marker in green; the first difficulty bar splits into two half-width bars; that player's projected points are the sum of both fixtures; the pitch carries a corner figure counting the doubles. |
| **F1-UP-03** | **A surname is too long for its slot.** Acceptance: surnames longer than eleven characters are cut at ten and closed with a full stop; the before/after mini labels use three letters unless two of the fifteen would collide, in which case both take four. Every model lookup keys off the untruncated name, never the display form. |
| **F1-UP-04** | **FPL's data feed is unreachable.** Acceptance: see F6. |
